steps.name: graph-schemas
command: from pathlib import Path; import json,jsonschema; s=json.loads(Path('schemas/graph-v1.schema.json').read_bytes()); jsonschema.Draft202012Validator.check_schema(s); [(jsonschema.Draft202012Validator(s).validate(json.loads(Path(k+'-graph.json').read_bytes()))) for k in ('research','documentation','delivery')]; print('PASS all three graph schemas')
